description: This file is a Swift source file defining logging utilities for an application, including log level settings, log handlers for system and file logging, label parsing, and logging system bootstrap. It also extends existing logging classes and manages metadata for log messages.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults, defaults to .info if not set.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if file logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs bootstrap of the logging system if it has not been initialized.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label for logging based on subsystem and category.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components.
